environmentVariables.description: Strac API key. Request one at https://www.strac.io/mcp-integrations. Keys are prefixed sk_live_ (production) or sk_test_ (sandbox).

environmentVariables.description: Override the Strac API base URL. Defaults to https://api.live.tokenidvault.com for sk_live_ keys and https://api.test.tokenidvault.com for sk_test_ keys.
environmentVariables.name: STRAC_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60.
environmentVariables.name: STRAC_API_TIMEOUT
